faqs.q: Sec. 6-143. - Special event permit application documents.
faqs.a:
An applicant shall fully complete an application packet for a special event permit
               as required by the local licensing authority and applicable statutes. No application
               for a special event permit shall be accepted by the city until such application has
               been properly completed in all respects as determined by the city clerk.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
